description: Cross-solver validation policy (TORCWA <-> Meep). The agent asks the user once and edits this file.

modes_available.off: no FDTD check (not recommended for anything that is reported)
modes_available.final: full validation (V2) of the final designs only
modes_available.every_stage: quick validation (V1) of the candidates at every decision point, full validation (V2) at the end
